cards.title: Plan it
cards.outcome: A plan with its steps, risks and open questions, and each step as a job you can start.

cards.title: Build a feature
cards.outcome: A pull request with the change, checked by tests and a review, after QE acceptance.

cards.title: Fix a bug
cards.outcome: A pull request with the fix and the checks that show it holds, after QE acceptance.

cards.title: Migrate or modernize
cards.outcome: A planned move with a confirmed cutover, proof the new path behaves like the old one, and the old path removed.

cards.title: Refactor or polish
cards.outcome: A pull request that restructures or tidies code with its behaviour unchanged, after QE acceptance.

cards.title: Prepare a release
cards.outcome: A release pull request: versions bumped, changelog cut from what merged, and a GO or NO-GO readiness verdict.

cards.title: Start something new
cards.outcome: A new CLI, service, library or MCP server in a pull request, tested and reviewed; an MCP server is installed after your consent.

cards.title: Studio plugin
cards.outcome: A studio editor plugin designed, built, tested and installed after your consent.

cards.title: Plan tests
cards.outcome: The test gaps in the code, then a risk-ranked test plan file in a pull request, ready to automate.

cards.title: Write and run tests
cards.outcome: A pull request with behaviour tests that ran green under your own test setup.

cards.title: Keep the suite healthy
cards.outcome: A pull request that fixes flaky, weak, rotten or slow tests, with the suite run green under your own setup.

cards.title: Incident or root cause
cards.outcome: What broke and why, each cause cited to a code or log line, with the fix handed to Bug.

cards.title: Competitive or market analysis
cards.outcome: How others do it, with every claim cited to a source.

cards.title: Due diligence
cards.outcome: A cited review of a target's documents: what holds, what is missing, what is a risk.

cards.title: Research a question
cards.outcome: A cited answer from outside sources.

cards.title: Reconstruct what happened
cards.outcome: A timeline of what changed and why, each event cited to a commit, pull request or run.

cards.title: Analyze a codebase
cards.outcome: A cited account of the code: how it works, what it does as requirements, or where its docs are wrong.

cards.title: Map requirements
cards.outcome: Each requirement you pick traced to the code that meets it, or marked unmet, cited.

cards.title: Analyze documents
cards.outcome: What a set of documents says, compared and cited to the page.

cards.title: Review a change
cards.outcome: A verdict on a pull request or branch: approve, conditional or reject, with every finding cited.

cards.title: Critique a document, proposal or claim
cards.outcome: Where an argument holds and where it does not, cited to the page.

cards.title: Risk analysis
cards.outcome: A risk matrix for a change or an area: failure modes, likelihood, impact and mitigations, cited.

cards.title: Security and compliance review
cards.outcome: Security, privacy or compliance findings, each cited to code, with the fix to make.

cards.title: Decide (ADR)
cards.outcome: Options scored by seats that did not write them, and your pick; the ADR is then written by Document · Docs in the repo, filled in.

cards.title: Document
cards.outcome: A document, a deck or Markdown docs in your repository, grounded in your work.

cards.title: Interactive page
cards.outcome: A versioned web page document in studio that you can edit in place and export as PDF.

cards.title: Demo video
cards.outcome: A captioned video of your app, recorded and reviewed by a second seat.

cards.title: Respond to an ask
cards.outcome: A response to an RFP, RFI or questionnaire, every answer traced to its source.

cards.title: Rework an artifact
cards.outcome: An artifact condensed, re-aimed, generalized, converted or refreshed, faithful to its source.

cards.title: Communicate
cards.outcome: A narrative, meeting prep, demo script, status update or message, grounded in your work.

cards.title: Estimate and price
cards.outcome: Effort and price from a scope document, with the assumptions named.

cards.title: Model run cost
words: how much will it cost to run
cards.outcome: What a planned body of work will cost to run, from its documents and your run history.

cards.title: Backlog from requirements
cards.outcome: Epics, stories and tasks drafted from the requirements you pick, each traced to its requirement.

cards.title: Roles and operating model
cards.outcome: Who does what: roles, responsibilities, decision rights and cadences, as a document.

cards.title: Analyze runs
cards.outcome: How well the system's own judgments held on the runs you pick: needs-you, floors, QE verdicts, who built it, routing.

cards.title: Review recent work
cards.outcome: Recommendations across every run since the last review, with the numbers behind each.

cards.title: Propose rules and memories
cards.outcome: Steering rules, memories or knowledge, proposed for you to approve; nothing applies until you do.

cards.title: Evaluate rules
cards.outcome: Which steering rules catch what they should, which miss, and which fire on good work.

cards.title: Retro
cards.outcome: What went well and badly over a stretch of work, and the actions as proposals you approve.
